edges.reason: transfer() delegates execution to _transfer().
transferFrom() delegates execution to _transfer().
approve() delegates to _approve().
_msgSender() supplies the from address for transfer().
_msgSender() is used as spender in transferFrom allowance update.
onlyOwner compares _msgSender() against _owner, so caller controls authorization.
_transfer requires _msgSender() to equal router or pair under cooldownEnabled.
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
cooldown[to] is set from block.timestamp, creating a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is passed as deadline in addLiquidityETH during startTrading.
block.timestamp is passed as swap deadline in swapTokensForEth.
_transfer enforces require(!bots[from] && !bots[to]).
_transfer enforces require(amount <= _maxTxAmount).
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth while processing a transfer, allowing state changes around an external call.
_transfer sends ETH via sendETHToFee during transfer processing.
_transfer finishes by calling _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth calls the router swap function.
sendETHToFee performs native transfer to _teamAddress.
sendETHToFee performs native transfer to _marketingFunds.
startTrading calls addLiquidityETH with contract ETH.
startTrading assigns uniswapV2Router.
startTrading creates and stores uniswapV2Pair.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth on the contract balance.
manualsend calls sendETHToFee with contract ETH balance.
blockBots writes the bots mapping, gated by onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent writes _maxTxAmount, gated by onlyOwner.
onlyOwner reads _owner for the authorization check.
renounceOwnership writes _owner to address(0).
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard updates _rTotal through _reflectFee.
_transferStandard subtracts/adds _rOwned balances for sender and recipient.
_approve writes _allowances owner/spender entry.
The external router swap can re-enter _transfer through token callbacks before transfer state is finalized.
ETH transfer to _teamAddress can trigger a fallback that re-enters transfer logic.
ETH transfer to _marketingFunds can trigger a fallback that re-enters transfer logic.
_getValues reads _taxFee when computing token values.
_getValues reads _teamFee when computing token values.
_transfer indirectly modifies _taxFee via removeAllFee/restoreAllFee in the fee path.
swapTokensForEth lockTheSwap modifier sets/clears inSwap.
unblockBot writes the bots mapping, gated by onlyOwner.

normalization_plan.reason: from is the source address argument consumed by _transfer's checks and accounting.
to is the destination address argument consumed by _transfer's checks and accounting.
amount is the value argument bounded by _maxTxAmount inside _transfer.
contractTokenBalance is passed directly as the swap amount argument.
contractETHBalance is passed directly to sendETHToFee for distribution.
tokenAmount is the swap input consumed by the router external call.
amount is the ETH value split between the two trasfer operations in sendETHToFee.
bots_ array is iterated to write the bots mapping in the owner-only loop.
notbot address key is written to the bots mapping in the owner-only function.
